comments.body: is it true that it passes under AUTH=none? i think none only allows viewing not writes

code_window:
1  const router = require('./routes/upload');
     2  
     3  let setup = {
     4      // Once the app initializes
     5      onceInit: (s) => {
     6          // Image upload is a Configure-page (admin) action, so it uses the same
     7          // authorization posture as the /api/configure routes (see
     8          // API/Backend/Config/setup.js): ensureAdmin gates it to admin/lead
     9          // sessions (and passes under AUTH=none), not ensureUser/stopGuests.
    10          s.app.use(
    11              s.ROOT_PATH + '/api/cardplugin',
    12              s.ensureAdmin(),
    13              s.checkHeadersCodeInjection,
    14              s.setContentType,
    15              router
    16          );
    17      },
    18      // Once the server starts
    19      onceStarted: (s) => {},
    20      // Once all tables sync
    21      onceSynced: (s) => {},
    22  };
    23  
    24  module.exports = setup;
